script.story_title_en: The Deepavali kolam and a brother's words
script.logline_en: Back from a night shift on Deepavali morning, bus conductor Muthu finds fault with his sister Kayal's first big kolam; one quiet question from her makes him look again and see the peacock she drew for him in the middle.
script.originality_note_en: A tired brother's first word on his sister's Deepavali kolam is a complaint, until he notices the peacock at its centre was drawn for him, which is the ripe fruit he walked past.
script.meaning_ta: இனிமையான சொற்கள் தன்னிடம் இருக்கும்போதே கடுமையான சொற்களைச் சொல்வது, கனிந்த பழம் கையில் இருக்கும்போது அதை விட்டுவிட்டுக் காயைப் பறித்துத் தின்பது போன்றது.
script.meaning_en: Speaking harsh words when kind ones are right there is like leaving the ripe fruit in your hand and picking the unripe one to eat.

cast.look_en: Medium height, sturdy build, round face, medium-brown skin, short wavy black hair, clean-shaven, a small mole on his left cheek, tired eyes, no glasses.
cast.outfit_en: A khaki conductor's half-sleeve shirt and khaki trousers, a brown leather conductor's bag on a strap across his chest, black sandals.
cast.voice_en: a firm, tired 28-year-old Tamil man's voice

cast.look_en: Slim, oval face, wheatish skin, shoulder-length wavy black hair in a half ponytail, a small red bindi, small silver jhumka earrings, no nose stud, large expressive eyes.
cast.outfit_en: A mustard-yellow cotton churidar with a maroon dupatta tied around her waist, glass bangles in green and gold on both wrists, barefoot.
cast.voice_en: a bright, soft 21-year-old Tamil woman's voice

locations.description_en: The front of a small one-storey house in a Tamil Nadu town on Deepavali morning: a swept, dry, smooth grey cement front yard, two red-oxide steps up to a teak front door with a mango-leaf thoranam strung across the top, a low compound wall painted pale blue with a blue wooden gate on the left, a tulsi pot on a small stand by the steps, a row of small clay diyas along the edge of the top step.
locations.light_en: Just after sunrise, soft golden sunlight from the left, long gentle shadows, a clear pale-blue sky; the diyas are lit from shot 7 on.
locations.blocking_en: The kolam lies in the middle of the yard; Kayal kneels on its right edge facing left; Muthu stands at the gate side on the left facing right, looking down at it.

props.description_en: A large round Deepavali kolam about 1.5 m across drawn on the cement in white rice-flour lines with loops and dots, coloured with rangoli powder in magenta, orange and yellow, and in its exact centre a peacock in blue and green with a fanned tail; a few lines on its outer edge are slightly uneven.
A small round brass bowl full of white kolam powder.
Small terracotta clay diyas with cotton wicks, each with a small steady flame once lit.
Muthu's worn brown leather conductor's bag on a strap across his chest, no writing.

hooks.narration_ta: நல்லது முன்னால இருந்தாலும், முதல்ல குறை தான் தெரியுதா?
கோலத்துல நடுவுல இருந்த மயில், அவனுக்காக தான்.

segments.speaker: muthu
segments.delivery: tired, irritated, blunt; frowning, no smile

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: ராத்திரி டியூட்டி முடிஞ்சு வந்த முத்து, பார்த்ததும் குறை தான் சொன்னான்.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: கயல் கையில இருந்த கோலப்பொடி, அப்படியே நின்னுச்சு.

segments.speaker: kayal
segments.narration_ta: அண்ணா... இதுல ஒண்ணு கூடவா நல்லா இல்ல?
segments.delivery: quiet, hurt, steady; not crying, not smiling

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: முத்து மறுபடி பார்த்தான். நடுவுல, அவனுக்கு பிடிச்ச மயில்.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: இனிய உளவாக இன்னாத கூறல் கனிஇருப்பக் காய்கவர்ந் தற்று. பழம் கையில இருக்கும்போது, காயை எதுக்கு பறிக்கணும்?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: இனிய சொல் இருக்கும்போது, கசப்பான சொல் எதுக்கு?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: முதல்ல குறை சொல்லுற உங்க அண்ணன், அக்காவை டேக் பண்ணுங்க!

shots.action_en: Muthu, just back from his night shift, frowns down at Kayal's kolam and says his line sharply.
shots.camera_en: Low static medium shot from the kolam's edge, looking up at Muthu, Kayal kneeling at the right edge of frame.
shots.image_prompt_en: Muthu standing at the gate side of the yard in his khaki uniform with the bag across his chest, frowning down at the kolam towards the camera, face clearly visible; Kayal kneeling at the right edge of frame beside the kolam holding the brass bowl, looking up at him.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Muthu frowns and says his line sharply, facing the camera, irritated and tired, with no smile at any moment; Kayal holds still, mouth closed, looking up at him. Nothing else moves.

shots.action_en: Muthu points at the uneven outer lines and says everything is crooked; Kayal's face falls.
shots.camera_en: Static medium two-shot from the steps side, both faces in view.
shots.image_prompt_en: Muthu standing on the left, frowning, pointing down at the uneven outer lines of the kolam; Kayal kneeling on the right with the brass bowl in her hands, her proud expression starting to fade, both faces in view.
shots.motion_prompt_en: For the first few seconds nobody speaks: Muthu looks over the kolam, frowning. Then Muthu says his line flatly, frowning, pointing at the edge; no smile at any moment. Kayal's face slowly falls; her mouth stays closed. The brass bowl stays in her two hands the whole time.

shots.action_en: Close on Kayal's hands: the pinch of white powder stops mid-line; she lowers the bowl.
shots.camera_en: Close-up on her hands and the kolam line, shallow depth of field.
shots.image_prompt_en: Close-up of Kayal's hand with glass bangles, a pinch of white kolam powder between her fingers above an unfinished line, the brass bowl in her other hand.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Her fingers stop; a little powder falls; she slowly lowers the bowl onto the cement beside the kolam. Nobody speaks.

shots.action_en: Kayal looks up at Muthu and asks, quietly, whether not even one thing in it is nice.
shots.camera_en: Static medium close-up on Kayal from Muthu's side, her face fully to camera.
shots.image_prompt_en: Kayal kneeling beside the kolam, looking up towards the camera, hurt but steady, her face fully in view, hands resting on her knees, nothing in her hands.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Kayal says her line quietly, looking up into the camera, hurt but steady, no smile and no tears; her hands stay on her knees, nothing near her mouth.

shots.action_en: Muthu looks again: top-down on the kolam, its centre a blue-and-green peacock.
shots.camera_en: Top-down view of the whole kolam, then a slow push-in towards the peacock at its centre.
shots.image_prompt_en: Top-down view of the whole round kolam on the grey cement in morning light, the blue-and-green peacock at its exact centre, the tips of Muthu's sandals at the bottom edge of frame.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Slow push-in from the whole kolam to the peacock at its centre; morning light; nothing else moves.

shots.action_en: Hold on the peacock at the kolam's centre.
shots.camera_en: Top-down view of the whole kolam, then a slow push-in towards the peacock at its centre.
shots.image_prompt_en: Second cut from shot 5's clip (see shot 5): its last frame held with a slow push-in.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Second cut from shot 5's clip (see shot 5): its last frame held with a slow push-in.

shots.action_en: Muthu crouches down beside the peacock, softens and tells her it is beautiful; Kayal's face lifts.
shots.camera_en: Static medium two-shot at kolam level, both faces in view.
shots.image_prompt_en: Muthu crouching on the left beside the kolam, his bag pushed to his back, looking at the peacock and then at Kayal, his face softening; Kayal kneeling on the right, looking at him.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Muthu says his line softly to Kayal, facing her and the camera, with a small apologetic smile; Kayal's face slowly lifts into a smile while her mouth stays closed. Nobody holds anything.

shots.action_en: Brother and sister kneel together colouring the last petals of the kolam while the diyas on the step burn.
shots.camera_en: Wide static shot from the steps, the sunrise behind the gate.
shots.image_prompt_en: Muthu and Kayal kneeling side by side at the edge of the kolam in the golden morning light, Muthu sprinkling orange rangoli powder into a petal, Kayal guiding his hand, the row of lit clay diyas on the step in the foreground.
shots.motion_prompt_en: They colour one petal together, Kayal smiling and pointing, Muthu nodding; the diya flames flicker gently. Nobody speaks; mouths closed.

shots.action_en: Close on the finished peacock as Kayal places one lit diya beside it and Muthu's hand adds a last dot of colour.
shots.camera_en: Close shot on the peacock at kolam level, shallow depth of field.
shots.image_prompt_en: Close shot of the finished blue-and-green peacock in the kolam, Kayal's hand with green and gold bangles placing a lit clay diya beside it, Muthu's hand above it with a pinch of yellow powder.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Kayal sets the diya down; Muthu drops a last dot of yellow powder on the peacock's crest; the flame flickers. Slow push-in.

shots.action_en: Hold on the peacock and the lit diya, slow push-in, under the tag line.
shots.camera_en: Close shot on the peacock at kolam level, shallow depth of field.
shots.image_prompt_en: Second cut from shot 8's clip (see shot 8): its last frame held with a slow push-in.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Second cut from shot 8's clip (see shot 8): its last frame held with a slow push-in.
